title: Have these builders created Yukon's fanciest outhouses?
description:
Two contractors have gone all out, to build a couple of posh potties for mountain bikers on Carcross's renowned trail network. 'I just wanted to do something unique.' To read more: http://cbc.ca/1.4193026
